ModMetaData.name: Warcasket Weapon Quality
ModMetaData.author: DanZinagri
ModMetaData.description:
Warcasket weapons now have quality like normal weapons, and are crafted normally at the machining table.
Warcasket melee weapons are also made from any metal - plasteel, uranium, silver, gold, bioferrite or a modded one - instead of always steel, with the usual material effects on damage, cooldown, work and hit points.
